# Energy for the Future

# From here, you can kick-start your career.

### Apply now for an exciting job at RWE!

[To the Jobs][203]

## Spotlight @ RWE.com

Wednesday, April 1, 2026

#### Did you hear? Solar powers our lives

... for your coffee, your classrooms, your work. Solar powers the equivalent of half of all European
homes. Together with energy storage, solar power is lowering energy bills, while supporting
communities, farmers and the local as well as national economy.

[ More information ][204]
Friday, March 6, 2026

#### What happens to dismantled wind turbines and decommissioned power stations?

The circular economy is an essential aspect of planning modern energy facilities. Recycling and
re-use concepts ensure that valuable resources are preserved, and raw materials are fed back into
the production cycle.

[ Read more ][205]
Friday, March 6, 2026

#### Why Resilience Is the Decade’s Defining Challenge

Markus Krebber highlights the urgency of a robust energy system.

[ To the statement ][206]
Wednesday, January 7, 2026

#### Powering the Future

Rising demand, strategic investments, and the path to growth in 2026. Markus Krebber outlines the
main trends shaping the energy sector in 2026 – from surging demand driven by electrification and AI
to the urgent need for stable investment frameworks and a strategy for sustainable, affordable
energy.

[ Read more ][207]
Thursday, November 13, 2025

#### Only five DAX companies on track for Paris climate targets

The latest “whatif?” report by right° confirms that RWE is among the few DAX companies with climate
strategies aligned with the Paris Agreement. This recognition encourages to continue its path to
climate neutrality by 2040. Earlier this year, RWE’s strategy was certified by the Science Based
Targets initiative.

[ More on climate protection ][208]

## "The best energy company we can be!"

With more than 125 years of successful history behind us, RWE has undergone fundamental change and
is now a leading supplier of renewables worldwide. With wind farms, solar power and battery storage
facilities in many countries. Even today, most of our core business is green electricity.

And we want to get better and better, investing billions of euros in renewables and entering the
promising hydrogen technology at full speed. Together, we have achieved a lot and we will continue
on our path: For a sustainable future, for achieving net zero emissions by 2040 - for the best
energy company we can be!

[Our strategy at a glance][209]

To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports
HTML5 video

## Our energy for a sustainable life

RWE has reliably supplied people and companies with electricity for more than 125 years – night and
day. Many of us take electricity for granted. As well as the fact that it comes out of our sockets
at any time. And we can, because power generators like RWE make sure that it does. Decarbonisation
and sustainability are key components of our corporate strategy. And we have a clear objective:
climate-neutral by 2040.

Together with our partners we develop innovative solutions and drive technological progress for our

energy supply for future generations. RWE is changing, its renewables business is expanding
massively and is adapting to meet the new challenges posed within the existing business.

Interested in joining RWE? As an employee you have countless opportunities to become part of our

shaping the future of the energy transition.

Our employees see challenges as opportunities. They are guided by our set of core values: trust,

## Spotlight @ RWE.com

Wednesday, April 1, 2026

#### Did you hear? Solar powers our lives

... for your coffee, your classrooms, your work. Solar powers the equivalent of half of all European
homes. Together with energy storage, solar power is lowering energy bills, while supporting
communities, farmers and the local as well as national economy.

[ More information ][204]
Friday, March 6, 2026

#### What happens to dismantled wind turbines and decommissioned power stations?

The circular economy is an essential aspect of planning modern energy facilities. Recycling and
re-use concepts ensure that valuable resources are preserved, and raw materials are fed back into
the production cycle.

[ Read more ][205]
Friday, March 6, 2026

#### Why Resilience Is the Decade’s Defining Challenge

Markus Krebber highlights the urgency of a robust energy system.

[ To the statement ][206]
Wednesday, January 7, 2026

#### Powering the Future

Rising demand, strategic investments, and the path to growth in 2026. Markus Krebber outlines the
main trends shaping the energy sector in 2026 – from surging demand driven by electrification and AI
to the urgent need for stable investment frameworks and a strategy for sustainable, affordable
energy.

[ Read more ][207]
Thursday, November 13, 2025

#### Only five DAX companies on track for Paris climate targets

The latest “whatif?” report by right° confirms that RWE is among the few DAX companies with climate
strategies aligned with the Paris Agreement. This recognition encourages to continue its path to
climate neutrality by 2040. Earlier this year, RWE’s strategy was certified by the Science Based
Targets initiative.

[ More on climate protection ][208]

## "The best energy company we can be!"

With more than 125 years of successful history behind us, RWE has undergone fundamental change and
is now a leading supplier of renewables worldwide. With wind farms, solar power and battery storage
facilities in many countries. Even today, most of our core business is green electricity.

And we want to get better and better, investing billions of euros in renewables and entering the
promising hydrogen technology at full speed. Together, we have achieved a lot and we will continue
on our path: For a sustainable future, for achieving net zero emissions by 2040 - for the best
energy company we can be!

[Our strategy at a glance][209]

To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports
HTML5 video

## Our energy for a sustainable life

RWE has reliably supplied people and companies with electricity for more than 125 years – night and
day. Many of us take electricity for granted. As well as the fact that it comes out of our sockets
at any time. And we can, because power generators like RWE make sure that it does. Decarbonisation
and sustainability are key components of our corporate strategy. And we have a clear objective:
climate-neutral by 2040.

# Wind technology powering tomorrow's energy systems

Siemens Gamesa is a global leader in wind energy, supporting companies and countries worldwide in
building resilient, affordable, and sustainable energy systems that accelerate the energy
transition.

[ [icon] Explore products and services ][28]
[Omterra logo following the announcement of the rebrand from Siemens Gamesa and Siemens Energy.]
Siemens Gamesa and Siemens Energy will become Omterra
Same team, same commitment – a new brand. Driven by our purpose to energize society, our strategy,
and our values.
[ Read our official announcement ][29]
1. Onshore
2. Offshore
3. Service

Your trusted technology partner

#### Onshore

Operating in 81 countries, Siemens Gamesa offers an extensive range of onshore wind turbine
technologies to cover all wind classes and site conditions. By listening to our customers - and
backed up by over 40 years of experience - we know just what it takes to develop and manage a
successful onshore project.

[
[icon]
Read more ][30]

Powerful performance

#### Offshore

Leading the way forward, our engineers and technicians pioneered the offshore sector back in 1991,
with the world’s first wind power plant in Denmark. Since then, Siemens Gamesa has grown to become
the global leader in offshore power generation. Offering full-scope solutions and services, our
people and products will guarantee the success of your next offshore project.

[
[icon]
Read more ][31]

World-class maintenance

#### Service

Siemens Gamesa has a proven track record of excellence in operation and maintenance. Leveraging
scale and global reach, we offer a flexible service portfolio that can be tailored to our customers’
diverse operating models. We also provide advanced diagnostics and digitalization capabilities, as
well as customized offshore offerings.

[
[icon]
Read more ][32]

**Career**

#### Passionate about renewables

It takes the brightest minds to be a technology leader. It takes imagination to create green energy
for the generations to come. At Siemens Gamesa we make real what matters.

[ Join the team at Siemens Gamesa ][33]

**Sustainability**

#### Delivering sustainability through actions

This decade will be judged on our ability to take the steps needed to keep global temperature rises
this century to between 1.5 and 2.0 degrees Celsius, as well as deliver a fairer and more equal
world. That is why as part of our Sustainability Vision 2040, we are focused not just on the targets
we set, but instead on the actions that are needed to deliver on them.

[ More information ][34]
[Siemens Gamesa SG 15-236 offshore wind turbine installation]

### The next milestone on Siemens Gamesa's industrialization journey: SG 15-236

Offshore wind is entering a new era—one defined by scale, standardization, and technology-proven
reliability. With the introduction of the SG 15-236, Siemens Gamesa marks the next major step in the
industrialization of offshore wind energy.

 
* [ Read more ][35]

### Sustainability: From nice-to-have to prerequisite for winning

In popular culture, wind turbines often serve as a type of visual shorthand for the dream of a
sustainable future. But in the real world, sustainability considerations have evolved into strategic
drivers and enablers for our company and customers in Siemens Gamesa.

## The global leader in sustainable energy solutions

We're on a mission to transform the global energy system. With a dedicated team of +35,000
employees, we work every day to shape a more sustainable future by designing, installing, and
maintaining wind energy projects worldwide.

We believe wind power will form the backbone of tomorrow’s energy system. That's why we're steadfast
in our commitment to solutions that drive the vital transition to renewable energy, with wind at the
core.

## Our sustainable energy solutions

[ [Onshore wind turbines] ][143]

##### Onshore wind turbines

We lead the onshore wind market with over 40 years of expertise, specialising in wind turbine design
and development.

[ Explore our onshore wind turbine solutions ][144]
[ [Offshore wind turbines] ][145]

##### Offshore wind turbines

We have an unrivalled track record of making wind work at sea, bringing offshore wind to life in
even the most challenging environments.

[ Explore our offshore wind turbine solutions ][146]
[ [Service] ][147]

##### Service

We maintain the world's largest wind turbine fleet, spanning over 56,000 turbines across 72
countries.

[ Explore our service solutions ][148]
[ [Development] ][149]

##### Development

We turn renewable energy visions into reality by developing high-quality renewable energy projects
with value.

[ Explore our project development solutions ][150]

## What makes a technology leader?

At Vestas, technology leadership means delivering lasting value. Through scalable, reliable, and
sustainable solutions, we deliver long-term value for customers and society - strengthening energy
systems and accelerating the transition to a more secure and sustainable future.

[ Discover more here ][151]

**About Ørsted**

Ørsted is a global leader in developing, constructing, and operating offshore wind farms, with a
core focus on Europe. Backed by 35 years of experience in offshore wind, Ørsted has 10.2 GW of
installed offshore capacity and 8.1 GW under construction. Ørsted’s total installed renewable energy
capacity spanning Europe, Asia Pacific, and North America exceeds 18 GW across a portfolio that also
includes onshore wind, solar power, energy storage, bioenergy plants, and energy trading. Widely
recognised as a global sustainability leader, Ørsted is guided by its vision of a world that runs
entirely on green energy. Headquartered in Denmark, Ørsted employs approximately 7,700 people.

# The world’s leading offshore wind company

[Learn more about who we are][92]

Across Europe and beyond, Ørsted powers millions of homes and businesses with homegrown renewable
energy, strengthening energy security and advancing our vision of a world that runs entirely on
green energy.

### Interim report for the first quarter of 2026

Q1 2026 financial results are now available. Explore the interim report to see how we’re delivering
on our vision for a greener future.
[View Q1 2026 interim report][93]

### An end-to-end partner for offshore wind projects

### A more sustainable energy transition

Renewable energy helps further the energy transition, but developing, building, and operating
offshore wind farms might also come with adverse impacts.

From decarbonisation and protecting biodiversity to supporting local communities and maintaining
rigorous governance, we work tirelessly to ensure a sustainable energy transition.
[Explore our work with sustainability][113]

### Working at Ørsted

Headquartered in Denmark, Ørsted is a global company with a growing portfolio of offshore wind farms
worldwide. We have offices and operations across three continents – Europe, Asia, and North America
– where you'll find exciting opportunities to build your career.

**About Ørsted**

Ørsted is a global leader in developing, constructing, and operating offshore wind farms, with a
core focus on Europe. Backed by 35 years of experience in offshore wind, Ørsted has 10.2 GW of
installed offshore capacity and 8.1 GW under construction. Ørsted’s total installed renewable energy
capacity spanning Europe, Asia Pacific, and North America exceeds 18 GW across a portfolio that also
includes onshore wind, solar power, energy storage, bioenergy plants, and energy trading. Widely
recognised as a global sustainability leader, Ørsted is guided by its vision of a world that runs
entirely on green energy. Headquartered in Denmark, Ørsted employs approximately 7,700 people.
Ørsted's shares are listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen (Orsted). In 2025, the group's operating profit
excluding new partnerships and cancellation fees was DKK 25.1 billion (EUR 3.4 billion). Visit
[orsted.com][123] or follow us on [LinkedIn][124] and [Instagram][125].

# RWE in the Americas

### Energizing the future

RWE Americas, a subsidiary of RWE, is a US-based energy company that is helping to meet the growing
demand for energy across the United States. Backed by RWE’s 125-year global legacy of managing
diverse power assets, RWE Americas operates approximately 13 GW of power projects across 27 states. 
With a talented workforce of 2,000 employees, RWE Americas develops, constructs and operates wind,
solar and battery storage projects, along with natural gas-powered generation, that safely delivers
affordable, reliable electricity to our customers.

[Solar panels in the foreground with wind turbines on a hillside under a bright sky, showcasing
renewable energy sources.]
**RWE Americas **is developing, building and operating homegrown and fastest-to-market generation
solutions, while supporting American economic growth and energy security.  RWE is committed to
responsible development, investing in local and rural communities, creating jobs and partnering with
stakeholders to support and strengthen the places where we live and work.
[Read more][61]
[A wind farm with several turbines on stilts in the ocean under a cloudy sky.]

**RWE Offshore Wind GmbH** is a global energy company for sustainable electricity generation based
on offshore wind power. The company’s international focus is on Europe, USA and selected markets in
Asia. Over the past 20 years, RWE has developed unique expertise in the offshore industry, as its 18
operating wind farms demonstrate.

[Read more on rwe.com][62]
[Aerial view of New York City's skyline showcasing tall skyscrapers and green spaces under a clear
blue sky.]

**RWE Trading Americas Inc.** (“RWETA”) represents a local connection to the North American energy
markets for RWE Supply & Trading GmbH. Based in New York City, an important hub for major energy
investors, traders, brokers, and policy drivers, RWETA’s activities primarily focus on the
management of existing and origination of new RWE Energy Transition Investments.

[Read more][63]

### Energizing the future

RWE Americas, a subsidiary of RWE, is a US-based energy company that is helping to meet the growing
demand for energy across the United States. Backed by RWE’s 125-year global legacy of managing
diverse power assets, RWE Americas operates approximately 13 GW of power projects across 27 states. 
With a talented workforce of 2,000 employees, RWE Americas develops, constructs and operates wind,
solar and battery storage projects, along with natural gas-powered generation, that safely delivers
affordable, reliable electricity to our customers.

[Solar panels in the foreground with wind turbines on a hillside under a bright sky, showcasing
renewable energy sources.]
**RWE Americas **is developing, building and operating homegrown and fastest-to-market generation
solutions, while supporting American economic growth and energy security.  RWE is committed to
responsible development, investing in local and rural communities, creating jobs and partnering with
stakeholders to support and strengthen the places where we live and work.
[Read more][61]
[A wind farm with several turbines on stilts in the ocean under a cloudy sky.]

**RWE Offshore Wind GmbH** is a global energy company for sustainable electricity generation based
on offshore wind power. The company’s international focus is on Europe, USA and selected markets in
Asia. Over the past 20 years, RWE has developed unique expertise in the offshore industry, as its 18
operating wind farms demonstrate.

[Read more on rwe.com][62]
[Aerial view of New York City's skyline showcasing tall skyscrapers and green spaces under a clear
blue sky.]

**RWE Trading Americas Inc.** (“RWETA”) represents a local connection to the North American energy
markets for RWE Supply & Trading GmbH. Based in New York City, an important hub for major energy
investors, traders, brokers, and policy drivers, RWETA’s activities primarily focus on the
management of existing and origination of new RWE Energy Transition Investments.

### We are leading the way to a modern energy world – with an extensive investment and growth
### strategy.

Data networks, mobility, industry, infrastructure, businesses, family: We all need energy. Society
is facing a major task as a result: meeting a growing need for electricity while protecting the
climate. RWE is one of the leading companies in the field of renewable energy. RWE is investing
billions of euros in expanding its generation portfolio, in particular in offshore and onshore wind,
solar energy and batteries. It is perfectly complemented by its global energy trading business.
Thanks to its integrated portfolio of renewables, battery storage and flexible generation, as well
as its broad project pipeline of possible new builds, RWE is well positioned to address the growing
global demand for electricity, particularly driving by further electrification and artificial
intelligence.

RWE Supply & Trading provides tailored energy solutions for large customers. RWE has locations in
the attractive markets of Europe, North America and the Asia-Pacific region. The company is
responsibly phasing out coal by 2030. RWE employs around 20,000 people worldwide and has a clear
target: to get to net zero by 2040. On its way there, the company has set itself ambitious targets
for all activities that cause greenhouse gas emissions. The Science Based Targets initiative has
confirmed that these emission reduction targets are in line with the Paris Agreement. Very much in
the spirit of the company’s purpose:

  ### Der BWO
  
  Der BWO ist die politische Interessenvertretung der Offshore-Wind-Branche in Deutschland. Wir
  bündeln die fachliche Expertise der Unternehmen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette, von den
  Herstellern über die Entwickler und Betreiber bis hin zu den Dienstleistern der
  Offshore-Windenergie. Der BWO setzt sich dafür ein, die politischen, regulatorischen und
  ökonomischen **Rahmenbedingungen** für den Ausbau der Offshore-Windenergie im Sinne der
  Energiewende zu **verbessern**. Der BWO ist für politische Akteure auf Landes- und Bundesebene
  zentraler Ansprechpartner zu allen Fragen der Windenergie auf See. Der BWO wertet aktuelle
  Entwicklungen aus und analysiert die Folgen künftiger regulatorischer Rahmenbedingungen.

  ### Der BWO
  
  Der BWO ist die politische Interessenvertretung der Offshore-Wind-Branche in Deutschland. Wir
  bündeln die fachliche Expertise der Unternehmen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette, von den
  Herstellern über die Entwickler und Betreiber bis hin zu den Dienstleistern der
  Offshore-Windenergie. Der BWO setzt sich dafür ein, die politischen, regulatorischen und
  ökonomischen **Rahmenbedingungen** für den Ausbau der Offshore-Windenergie im Sinne der
  Energiewende zu **verbessern**. Der BWO ist für politische Akteure auf Landes- und Bundesebene
  zentraler Ansprechpartner zu allen Fragen der Windenergie auf See. Der BWO wertet aktuelle
  Entwicklungen aus und analysiert die Folgen künftiger regulatorischer Rahmenbedingungen.

Baltic Power Offshore Wind Farm
WTG Installation
Poland

In July of 2025, Cadeler successfully completed the installation of the very first Vestas 15MW
turbine at the Baltic Power Offshore Wind Farm in the Baltic Sea - marking the beginning of another
significant wind farm project. Over the coming months, Cadeler’s Wind Osprey and her crew will carry
out the transport and installation of all the 76 offshore wind turbines from the Port of Rønne in
Bornholm, Denmark. When fully commissioned next year, the 1.2 GW wind farm will become Poland’s
first offshore wind farm, powering over 1.5 million Polish households, covering 3% of the country’s
electricity demand, and estimated to save 2.8 million tonnes of CO₂ emissions every year.

[ Learn More ][42]

Sofia Offshore Wind Farm
WTG Installation
United Kingdom

The 1.4 GW Sofia Offshore Wind Farm is developed by RWE and will be one of the largest single
offshore wind farms in the world. Cadeler's Wind Peak will assist Siemens Gamesa with the transport
and installation of 100 of the impressive 14MW WTGs. Half of them will be fitted with recyclable
blades from Siemens Gamesa’s blade manufacturing facility in Hull. Not only setting new standards
for sustainability, but also supporting jobs in coastal communities. When completed, the wind farm
will provide almost 1.2 million UK homes with their annual electricity needs. This means, more than
2.5 million tonnes of carbon emissions per year will be saved.

[ Learn More ][43]

He Dreiht Offshore Wind Farm
WTG Installation
Germany

The He Dreiht project, which will operate on a subsidy-free basis by EnBW, will highlight the
attractive turbine solution which Vestas is able to offer through its V236-15.0 MW platform.
Germany’s political ambitions to produce 20GW offshore wind energy by 2030 call for ground-breaking
technology, and thankfully Vestas is able to offer the needed solutions to reach these targets while
Cadeler will play its part to make the plans a reality.

[ Learn More ][44]

Borkum Riffgrund 3 Offshore Wind Farm
WTG Installation
Germany

Cadeler has finished the installation and transportation of offshore wind turbines at Borkum
Riffgrund 3 offshore wind farm in collaboration with Ørsted and Siemens Gamesa. With a capacity of
913 MW, Borkum Riffgrund 3 will become Germany’s largest offshore wind farm!

This milestone follows the works at the other Ørsted offshore wind farm, Gode Wind 3. For these two
combined projects, Cadeler has led the installation and transportation of 67 Siemens Gamesa 11MW
WTGs.

Cadeler’s wind installation vessel Wind Osprey was deployed for both projects. The first of the two
projects began in July 2024, after the jack-up vessel had undergone a large crane upgrade. With a
lifting capacity of 1,600 metric tons, the new Wind Osprey main crane secured a safe, timely and
efficient installation.

The wind farms are located adjacent to Ørsted's other offshore wind farms off the coast of Northern
Germany. The combined capacity of the wind farms at Gode Wind 3 and Borkum Riffgrund 3 will be 1.1
GW and they will power more than a million German households.

The completion of Borkum Riffgrund 3 marks the first time an offshore wind farm will not feature a
substation and instead will be directly connected to an offshore converter platform (DolWin
epsilon).

[ Learn More ][45]

Moray West Offshore Wind Farm
WTG Installation
United Kingdom

Cadeler has completed the offshore installation works at the Moray West offshore wind farm in
northern Scotland. This project represented a benchmark for the industry as it was the first-ever
commercial-scale installation of the Siemens Gamesa 14.7MW offshore wind turbine. Cadeler executed
the installation of all 60 of these next generation turbines. Our project began in the beginning of
2024, just after Wind Orca had undergone a large crane upgrade. With a lifting capacity of 1,600
metric tons, the new main crane secured a safe and efficient installation living up to all
expectations.

When fully operational, the wind farm will have the capacity to power up to 1.33 million homes with
renewable energy.

Congratulations to our great partners at Siemens Gamesa and OW Ocean Winds. This landmark project
represents another step forward in the pursuit of a greener and cleaner future! 

[ Installation Vessel: Wind Orca ][46]

Revolution Wind Offshore Wind Farm
WTG Installation
United States

Cadeler is installing offshore wind turbines at the 704 MW Revolution Wind offshore wind farm - its
first U.S. project, using the state-of-the-art Wind Scylla installation vessel.

Located off the coasts of Rhode Island and Connecticut, Revolution Wind is the nation’s first
multi-state offshore wind farm, developed by Ørsted and Global Infrastructure Partners' Skyborn
Renewables in a 50/50 joint venture. It will feature 65 Siemens Gamesa 11 MW turbines and provide
clean energy to over 350,000 homes, supporting both states' climate goals.

[ Learn More ][47]

Yunlin Offshore Wind Farm
WTG Installation
Taiwan

Cadeler and the team onboard Wind Zaratan have secured the completion of the offshore installation
works at Skyborn Renewables' Yunlin offshore wind farm in Taiwan. When in operation, the wind farm
will provide power to over 600,000 Taiwanese households, and it is already making a significant
impact, having fed over 1.6 TWh of renewable energy into the grid. The Yunlin offshore wind farm
consists of 80 Siemens Gamesa wind turbine generators and is Taiwan's first wind farm with monopile
foundations.

Congratulations to our partners at [Skyborn Renewables][48] and [Siemens Gamesa][49] for a
successful project completion.

[ Installation Vessel: Wind Zaratan ][50]

Hollandse Kust Zuid Offshore Wind Farm
WTG Installation
The Netherlands

Cadeler has been in charge of the transportation and installation (T&I) of all 139 Siemens Gamesa 11
MW wind turbines at the Hollandse Kust Zuid wind farm in the Netherlands.

Upon completion in June 2023, the wind farm took the record as the world’s largest single offshore
wind farm with a capacity of 1.5 GW. It also took the record as the first ever to be built without
subsidies. Today, the wind farm is producing enough renewable energy to power more than 1.5 million
Dutch households a year.

Baltic Power Offshore Wind Farm
WTG Installation
Poland

In July of 2025, Cadeler successfully completed the installation of the very first Vestas 15MW
turbine at the Baltic Power Offshore Wind Farm in the Baltic Sea - marking the beginning of another
significant wind farm project. Over the coming months, Cadeler’s Wind Osprey and her crew will carry
out the transport and installation of all the 76 offshore wind turbines from the Port of Rønne in
Bornholm, Denmark. When fully commissioned next year, the 1.2 GW wind farm will become Poland’s
first offshore wind farm, powering over 1.5 million Polish households, covering 3% of the country’s
electricity demand, and estimated to save 2.8 million tonnes of CO₂ emissions every year.

[ Learn More ][42]

Sofia Offshore Wind Farm
WTG Installation
United Kingdom

The 1.4 GW Sofia Offshore Wind Farm is developed by RWE and will be one of the largest single
offshore wind farms in the world. Cadeler's Wind Peak will assist Siemens Gamesa with the transport
and installation of 100 of the impressive 14MW WTGs. Half of them will be fitted with recyclable
blades from Siemens Gamesa’s blade manufacturing facility in Hull. Not only setting new standards
for sustainability, but also supporting jobs in coastal communities. When completed, the wind farm
will provide almost 1.2 million UK homes with their annual electricity needs. This means, more than
2.5 million tonnes of carbon emissions per year will be saved.

[ Learn More ][43]

He Dreiht Offshore Wind Farm
WTG Installation
Germany

The He Dreiht project, which will operate on a subsidy-free basis by EnBW, will highlight the
attractive turbine solution which Vestas is able to offer through its V236-15.0 MW platform.
Germany’s political ambitions to produce 20GW offshore wind energy by 2030 call for ground-breaking
technology, and thankfully Vestas is able to offer the needed solutions to reach these targets while
Cadeler will play its part to make the plans a reality.

[ Learn More ][44]

Borkum Riffgrund 3 Offshore Wind Farm
WTG Installation
Germany

Cadeler has finished the installation and transportation of offshore wind turbines at Borkum
Riffgrund 3 offshore wind farm in collaboration with Ørsted and Siemens Gamesa. With a capacity of
913 MW, Borkum Riffgrund 3 will become Germany’s largest offshore wind farm!

This milestone follows the works at the other Ørsted offshore wind farm, Gode Wind 3. For these two
combined projects, Cadeler has led the installation and transportation of 67 Siemens Gamesa 11MW
WTGs.

Cadeler’s wind installation vessel Wind Osprey was deployed for both projects. The first of the two
projects began in July 2024, after the jack-up vessel had undergone a large crane upgrade. With a
lifting capacity of 1,600 metric tons, the new Wind Osprey main crane secured a safe, timely and
efficient installation.

The wind farms are located adjacent to Ørsted's other offshore wind farms off the coast of Northern
Germany. The combined capacity of the wind farms at Gode Wind 3 and Borkum Riffgrund 3 will be 1.1
GW and they will power more than a million German households.

The completion of Borkum Riffgrund 3 marks the first time an offshore wind farm will not feature a
substation and instead will be directly connected to an offshore converter platform (DolWin
epsilon).

[ Learn More ][45]

Moray West Offshore Wind Farm
WTG Installation
United Kingdom

Cadeler has completed the offshore installation works at the Moray West offshore wind farm in
northern Scotland. This project represented a benchmark for the industry as it was the first-ever
commercial-scale installation of the Siemens Gamesa 14.7MW offshore wind turbine. Cadeler executed
the installation of all 60 of these next generation turbines. Our project began in the beginning of
2024, just after Wind Orca had undergone a large crane upgrade. With a lifting capacity of 1,600
metric tons, the new main crane secured a safe and efficient installation living up to all
expectations.

When fully operational, the wind farm will have the capacity to power up to 1.33 million homes with
renewable energy.

Congratulations to our great partners at Siemens Gamesa and OW Ocean Winds. This landmark project
represents another step forward in the pursuit of a greener and cleaner future! 

[ Installation Vessel: Wind Orca ][46]

Revolution Wind Offshore Wind Farm
WTG Installation
United States

Cadeler is installing offshore wind turbines at the 704 MW Revolution Wind offshore wind farm - its
first U.S. project, using the state-of-the-art Wind Scylla installation vessel.

Located off the coasts of Rhode Island and Connecticut, Revolution Wind is the nation’s first
multi-state offshore wind farm, developed by Ørsted and Global Infrastructure Partners' Skyborn
Renewables in a 50/50 joint venture. It will feature 65 Siemens Gamesa 11 MW turbines and provide
clean energy to over 350,000 homes, supporting both states' climate goals.

[ Learn More ][47]

Yunlin Offshore Wind Farm
WTG Installation
Taiwan

Cadeler and the team onboard Wind Zaratan have secured the completion of the offshore installation
works at Skyborn Renewables' Yunlin offshore wind farm in Taiwan. When in operation, the wind farm
will provide power to over 600,000 Taiwanese households, and it is already making a significant
impact, having fed over 1.6 TWh of renewable energy into the grid. The Yunlin offshore wind farm
consists of 80 Siemens Gamesa wind turbine generators and is Taiwan's first wind farm with monopile
foundations.

Congratulations to our partners at [Skyborn Renewables][48] and [Siemens Gamesa][49] for a
successful project completion.

# Propelling Renewable Energy Forward

Providing reliable, affordable and increasingly clean energy that powers your every day.

[View Project Timeline][26]

[Pause][27]

### Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind

## Our Clean Energy Future

Construction on Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind (CVOW), the largest offshore wind project in the
United States, is progressing on schedule. Onshore construction for transmission infrastructure
began in late 2023, and offshore construction commenced in early 2024.

Anchored in Hampton Roads, CVOW is transforming the local economy and beyond by attracting economic
development opportunities to create hundreds of good-paying clean energy jobs, millions in tax
revenues and hundreds of millions in economic benefits annually.

Once complete, CVOW will generate enough energy to power up to 660,000 homes, and it will add to our
diverse energy mix, which is essential for energy security, reliability and lowering fuel costs.

  #### 660,000 homes powered

  #### 2027 expected completion

[One spinning offshore wind turbine]

## Resources

Explore our full library of project resources for additional information on the project, the
transmission route, environmental mitigation and more.

[Find Resources][28]

### About

[Wrench Icon] The Project
[Lightbulb with money icon] Economic Benefits
[Whale Tail icon] Environmental Stewardship

## Delivering on Our Mission

We are committed to safely providing an all-of-the-above mix of power generation sources to meet
rising power demand, including offshore wind, to provide our customers with reliable, affordable and
increasingly clean energy.

CVOW is a 2.6-gigawatt project. Its 176 offshore wind turbines will generate enough carbon-free,
renewable energy to power up to 660,000 homes. Harnessing the power of the wind means this project
has expected fuel savings of $3 billion for customers during the project's first decade of
operations.

[Learn more about the CVOW project][29]

[Monopile installation in the CVOW lease area, and a wind turbine in the background.]

## Jobs for Today and Tomorrow

More than 800 Virginia-based workers are engaged on the project or with other businesses supporting
CVOW. To support ongoing operations and maintenance, more than 1,000 local jobs will be needed.

[Learn more about job creation][30]

[A bright yellow safety vest with the Dominion Energy logo hangs on the ship, with monopile
installation in the background]

## Protecting What Matters

We are committed to meeting the energy needs of our customers in an environmentally conscious
manner. Protecting natural and cultural resources is our duty as a responsible corporate citizen.

This is why we are taking extensive precautions to safeguard sensitive marine species, like the
North Atlantic right whale.

[Learn more about our efforts][31]

[Fish explore the artificial reef created at the base of the CVOW turbines]

We recognize that commercial fishing and the CVOW projects share a common ocean.

revenues and hundreds of millions in economic benefits annually.

Once complete, CVOW will generate enough energy to power up to 660,000 homes, and it will add to our
diverse energy mix, which is essential for energy security, reliability and lowering fuel costs.

## Delivering on Our Mission

We are committed to safely providing an all-of-the-above mix of power generation sources to meet
rising power demand, including offshore wind, to provide our customers with reliable, affordable and
increasingly clean energy.

CVOW is a 2.6-gigawatt project. Its 176 offshore wind turbines will generate enough carbon-free,
renewable energy to power up to 660,000 homes. Harnessing the power of the wind means this project
has expected fuel savings of $3 billion for customers during the project's first decade of
operations.

We are committed to meeting the energy needs of our customers in an environmentally conscious
manner. Protecting natural and cultural resources is our duty as a responsible corporate citizen.

# We're looking for innovators to work with us

As bp embarks on the most ambitious challenge in our 114-year history - our transformation from
international oil company (IOC) to integrated energy company (IEC) - we’re looking for technological
and commercial partners in a wide range of industries, sectors and specialisms.

[ See our collaboration hubs ][12]

##### Making changes for a better world

### How you can engage with us

Below you will find links to business unit collaboration hubs and live innovation campaigns. The
collaboration hubs are always on spaces where you can share your innovative products and services
with relevant teams within bp. Submissions to the collaboration hubs are regularly vetted and then
shared with relevant stakeholders within the businesses. Live innovation campaigns, time bound
searches for products and services to meet specific challenges bp are looking to overcome, feature a
brief of what we’re looking for, launch dates and submission deadlines.

### Reasons to work with us

How we can achieve our ambitions for people and the planet

#### Acceleration

You gain access to new customers, project revenue, and a streamlined collaboration process.

#### Co-creation

You can refine and scale your solution through real-world integration, while we benefit from rapid
technology deployments that solve specific business challenges.

#### Simplification

We both enjoy a transparent, standardised way of working that reduces administrative hurdles and
shortens the path to collaboration.

##### Be part of the change

### Our collaboration hubs

### Production & operations

In production & operations (P&O) our vision is to become an industry-leading hydrocarbons business
and the engine room of our integrated energy company. We will do this by always putting safety
first, reducing carbon emissions, improving efficiency, integrating across the value chain, and
flexibly deploying talent to the solve the biggest issues.

[ Learn more ][13]

### Customers & products

In customers & products (C&P), we’re a set of global and regional businesses serving millions of
diverse customers every day. We power our customers’ journeys whether they need fuel or a charge for
the road, lubricants products to keep engines moving or a convenient coffee and snack to recharge
themselves.

[ Learn more ][14]

### Supply, trading & shipping

Our ambition is to be the world's leading energy marketing, operations, and trading team. We are
always striving for more innovative digital solutions, sustainable outcomes and closer collaboration
across bp and beyond.

[ Learn more ][15]

### Gas & low carbon energy

Gas & low carbon energy (G&LCE) encompasses businesses helping to advance bp’s strategic
transformation from an international oil company to an integrated energy company.

[ Learn more ][16]

### Health, safety, environment & carbon

bp makes the safety and reliability of all of its operations our top priority. By focusing on
developing engineering and control systems that reduce hazards and support compliance, capability
and performance, we look to ensure all our people are safe and secure in the environment they work
in.

[ Learn more ][17]

### Open collaboration

If your business has technology that you think can help bp, but doesn't fit into one of our
business-driven campaigns, please share you details here!

[ Learn more ][18]

### FAQ'S

Frequently asked questions about partnerships with bp

## Why is bp running these hubs and campaigns?

We are using these hubs and campaigns to work with other companies to solve our most pressing
challenges. We believe being open to ideas from outside bp helps us get to solutions faster, and in
a way that provides open opportunities for companies of all sizes and from any location.

## How does it work?

Our collaboration hubs are on-all-the-time webpages, where you can provide your company's details if
you think you can support any of our core businesses. If you apply here, your details will be
reviewed and we'll get back in contact with you when we have relevant opportunities. Our campaigns
are usually run for 4-8 weeks. At the end of that period, the campaign page closes for applications.
At closure we review all applications, feed back to all, shortlist, and open direct dialogue with
shortlisted applicants.

## Can I speak directly with the team running campaigns?

Yes. You can do this by using the "Comment" functionality in the platform. When you submit a
comment, one of our team will receive notification and we'll get back to you ASAP.

Yes. You can always go into the platform and upload refreshed/new documentation. In fact, we

you think you can support any of our core businesses. If you apply here, your details will be
reviewed and we'll get back in contact with you when we have relevant opportunities. Our campaigns
are usually run for 4-8 weeks. At the end of that period, the campaign page closes for applications.
At closure we review all applications, feed back to all, shortlist, and open direct dialogue with
shortlisted applicants.

## Can I speak directly with the team running campaigns?

Yes. You can do this by using the "Comment" functionality in the platform. When you submit a
comment, one of our team will receive notification and we'll get back to you ASAP.

## Can I change my original submission?

Yes. You can always go into the platform and upload refreshed/new documentation. In fact, we
encourage you to do this, especially if your technology has evolved significantly since your
original submission. Please keep in mind that only non-confidential information should be uploaded.

## also our environment.

kilos** of aluminum into the surrounding seawater over a period of 25 years. CORROSION’S sustainable
ICCP technology releases a drastically reduced **1 kilo** of ICCP anode material over the same
period of time.

Get to know us...

## A new chapter in our history

December 2023 will forever mark a milestone in our company history, as we became part of the global
CS WIND corporation. The acquisition goes beyond a mere change in ownership; it marks a leap into a
future where our combined strengths will pave the way for optimized production and expanded reach.

**Supported by our global family
**The legacy of Bladt Industries and expertise in delivering high-quality solutions persists - now
bolstered by CS WIND's global resources and renamed CS WIND Offshore to underline our area of
expertise.

[
About us
][116]

## 20 years of experience with offshore wind

The reliable backbone of CS WIND Offshore is our technical skills and proven ability to execute
complex projects. We utilize our 20 years of experience from offshore wind every day when guiding
clients from first inquiry till we celebrate handover of the last structure.

**Cooperation is key
**High-quality solutions are the result of close cooperation between all project parties. With
experience from more than 50 wind farm projects, we can qualifiedly support clients on all issues
that may arise. Project criteria are known to change along the way - with open dialogue and
flexibility, our clients can rely on our ability to adjust, seek solutions, and achieve the desired
result. 

[
Solutions
][117]

## Making a difference

**Production facilities
**We need to and want to continually develop our expertise and our facilities - making sure we
deliver first-class projects to our clients every time, while also ensuring they are in safe hands
with their choice of supplier.

**QHSE compliance
**We work uncompromisingly with quality, health, safety, and environmental issues always striving to
improve our performance and capabilities.  This guarantees high-quality products, the highest
possible degree of safety for all personnel on every site, and protection of the environment.

[
In safe hands
][118]

## Foundation for the green energy transition offshore

CS WIND Offshore, based in Aalborg, Denmark, specializes in the production of premium offshore wind
foundations, utilizing decades of industry expertise. CS WIND Offshore operates as an independent
business unit in CS WIND Corporation, a global leader in the wind industry that originated in South
Korea. CS WIND Corporation has factories in Asia, Europe and North America to supply clients with
offshore wind turbine foundations, wind turbine towers, and other components for onshore and
offshore wind farms.

Change & Challenge

Get to know us...

## A new chapter in our history

December 2023 will forever mark a milestone in our company history, as we became part of the global
CS WIND corporation. The acquisition goes beyond a mere change in ownership; it marks a leap into a
future where our combined strengths will pave the way for optimized production and expanded reach.

**Supported by our global family
**The legacy of Bladt Industries and expertise in delivering high-quality solutions persists - now
bolstered by CS WIND's global resources and renamed CS WIND Offshore to underline our area of
expertise.

[
About us
][116]

## 20 years of experience with offshore wind

The reliable backbone of CS WIND Offshore is our technical skills and proven ability to execute
complex projects. We utilize our 20 years of experience from offshore wind every day when guiding
clients from first inquiry till we celebrate handover of the last structure.

**Cooperation is key
**High-quality solutions are the result of close cooperation between all project parties. With
experience from more than 50 wind farm projects, we can qualifiedly support clients on all issues
that may arise. Project criteria are known to change along the way - with open dialogue and
flexibility, our clients can rely on our ability to adjust, seek solutions, and achieve the desired
result. 

[
Solutions
][117]

## Making a difference

**Production facilities
**We need to and want to continually develop our expertise and our facilities - making sure we
deliver first-class projects to our clients every time, while also ensuring they are in safe hands
with their choice of supplier.

**QHSE compliance
**We work uncompromisingly with quality, health, safety, and environmental issues always striving to
improve our performance and capabilities.  This guarantees high-quality products, the highest
possible degree of safety for all personnel on every site, and protection of the environment.

[
In safe hands
][118]

## Foundation for the green energy transition offshore

CS WIND Offshore, based in Aalborg, Denmark, specializes in the production of premium offshore wind
foundations, utilizing decades of industry expertise. CS WIND Offshore operates as an independent
business unit in CS WIND Corporation, a global leader in the wind industry that originated in South
Korea. CS WIND Corporation has factories in Asia, Europe and North America to supply clients with
offshore wind turbine foundations, wind turbine towers, and other components for onshore and
offshore wind farms.

## About Data Insights Market

Data Insights Market is one of the leading providers of syndicated and customized research reports,
consulting services, and analytical information on markets and companies across the world. Data
Insights Market partners with clients in many countries and industry verticals such as A & D,
Chemical & material, Energy Power, F & B, Retail, Healthcare and many more to provide high value
market research reports and consulting services. Our skilled analysts work towards understanding the
specific needs of each client to produce relevant insights that most suit his individual needs.
Since its inception, Data Insights Market has continued to innovate, increased its product and
service portfolio, and remained focused on the needs of its clients to root out poor-quality data
and establish itself as a winning partner for businesses. DIM has a legacy of serving and
facilitating clients from all over the world and played a vital role in their success story. Our
clients include many types of organizations, the majority of which are Fortune 500 companies.

The 360-degree research methodology requires us to only dispense facilities based on our unique data
model so that the authenticity and integrity of the services are maintained. This methodology makes
sure that the analysis is comprehensive and accurate. We can provide services of importance to our
clients well within the time limit by keeping a close eye on relevant press releases, official
publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the
following: We use a variety of new, useful approaches to big data and the tools of qualitative and
quantitative marketing research to understand clients properly. The key objectives are to examine
niche markets, outline the main drivers, and indicate the most hazardous obstacles. We track major
local and global trends in this field and strive to balance the quality level within a given time
period while meeting the specialized and specialty needs of the industry.

# Everllence - Moving big things to zero

[ Learn more about our new name ][162]

What we do

## We provide decarbonization technologies for global shipping, energy generation, and industry

Shipping, power generation, and heavy industry produce nearly a third of the world’s carbon
emissions. These are the hardest sectors to decarbonize and the most essential to keep running.
Energy infrastructure operates at massive scale and is tightly interwoven with global supply chains.
Transforming it is complex – but it must start now. This is exactly where we come in. We develop the
technologies that make decarbonization practical and economical for the industries the world depends
on. From the engines that power global trade to the heat pumps that warm entire cities.

[Learn more about our Focus][163]

Future Technologies

## Explore our technologies for a net-zero future

[ Retrofits
][164]
[ Carbon Capture
][165]
[ Future Fuel Engines
][166]
[ Heat Pumps
][167]
[Quote]

> “We have the opportunity to decarbonize industries that are crucial for the world economy. That’s
> why we get out of bed every morning.”  

Dr Uwe Lauber, CEO Everllence

Industries

## We work across key sectors of the world economy – where every reduction in emissions counts most

[ Marine
][168]
[ Energy
][169]
[ Industries
][170]
[ Services
][171]

## What moves us forward

Career

### Working at Everllence

Are you looking to  leverage your existing knowledge and expertise to drive innovation? Or do you
want to  start your career with a global leader  in engineering and technology? Are you ready to
make a lasting impact as part of our team at Everllence and move big things to zero with us?

[ Learn more about our career opportunities
][172]
Digitalization

### Data is the future’s DNA

We at Everllence therefore enable you to increase the efficiency, reliability and maintenance of
your products. By introducing our digital key products CEON and PrimeServ Assist, we created a
comprehensive digital ecosystem that allows us to collect, combine and evaluate relevant data. This
databased ecosystem is our digital backbone and the base for new digital customer centric solutions
of the future.
[ Learn more about Digitalization at Everllence
][173]
[future-like visualization of a boat with digital components around it]

Discover Stories

## Gain deep insights into our projects

Discover Story

### From fertilizer to marine fuel

Ammonia is moving from concept to reality. In Japan, Everllence and its licensee Mitsui E&S are
testing the world's first commercial large-bore ME-LGIA engine, verifying consumption, emissions and
safety before the engine goes to sea on a bulk carrier. A decisive step toward carbon-free shipping.

[Read Story][174]

Discover Story

### Charting the IMO's course to net-zero

A one-year pause in the IMO Net-Zero Framework leaves the shipping industry without the rules it was
waiting for. Experts from Everllence and DNV explain what the framework still promises, why the
earliest entry into force is now 2028, and why the work on fuels, pricing and compliance must
continue regardless.

[Read Story][175]

# Everllence - Moving big things to zero

[ Learn more about our new name ][162]

What we do

## We provide decarbonization technologies for global shipping, energy generation, and industry

Shipping, power generation, and heavy industry produce nearly a third of the world’s carbon
emissions. These are the hardest sectors to decarbonize and the most essential to keep running.
Energy infrastructure operates at massive scale and is tightly interwoven with global supply chains.
Transforming it is complex – but it must start now. This is exactly where we come in. We develop the
technologies that make decarbonization practical and economical for the industries the world depends
on. From the engines that power global trade to the heat pumps that warm entire cities.

[Learn more about our Focus][163]

## What moves us forward

Career

### Working at Everllence

Are you looking to  leverage your existing knowledge and expertise to drive innovation? Or do you
want to  start your career with a global leader  in engineering and technology? Are you ready to
make a lasting impact as part of our team at Everllence and move big things to zero with us?

][172]
Digitalization

### Data is the future’s DNA

We at Everllence therefore enable you to increase the efficiency, reliability and maintenance of
your products. By introducing our digital key products CEON and PrimeServ Assist, we created a
comprehensive digital ecosystem that allows us to collect, combine and evaluate relevant data. This
databased ecosystem is our digital backbone and the base for new digital customer centric solutions
of the future.
[ Learn more about Digitalization at Everllence
][173]
[future-like visualization of a boat with digital components around it]

Discover Stories

## Gain deep insights into our projects

Discover Story

### From fertilizer to marine fuel

Ammonia is moving from concept to reality. In Japan, Everllence and its licensee Mitsui E&S are
testing the world's first commercial large-bore ME-LGIA engine, verifying consumption, emissions and
safety before the engine goes to sea on a bulk carrier. A decisive step toward carbon-free shipping.

[Read Story][174]

Discover Story

### Charting the IMO's course to net-zero

A one-year pause in the IMO Net-Zero Framework leaves the shipping industry without the rules it was
waiting for. Experts from Everllence and DNV explain what the framework still promises, why the
earliest entry into force is now 2028, and why the work on fuels, pricing and compliance must
continue regardless.

[Read Story][175]

## Reliable partners in renewable energy

With experience across **40+ countries**, a [global team][35] of over **2,200 people**, and a strong
international supply chain, FairWind supports [customers’ wind projects worldwide.][36]

Since 2008, we’ve grown both organically and through [strategic acquisitions][37], expanding our
geographic reach and diversifying our services to accelerate the **global energy transition**. We’re
proud to deliver solutions that create a **sustainable future** and a better world for generations
to come.

[ About FairWind ][38]

## Our offerings

With nearly two decades of experience in the renewable energy sector, FairWind delivers specialist
services across the full lifecycle of wind turbine operations. Our expert technicians support
onshore and offshore wind projects worldwide, helping developers, OEMs, and asset owners install,
maintain, and optimise their assets safely and efficiently.

Installation & Preassembly

FairWind supports wind farm construction with experienced technical teams delivering turbine
[installation and preassembly][39] services. Our specialists ensure turbines are assembled safely,
efficiently, and to the highest quality standards, supporting projects from early construction
through to commissioning.

Operations & Maintenance

Our preventive and corrective [maintenance services][40] help wind turbines operate reliably and
efficiently throughout their operational life. By identifying issues early and responding quickly
when faults occur, we help minimise downtime and maximise energy production.

Decommissioning & Repowering

As wind farms reach the end of their operational life, FairWind supports customers with safe,
efficient [decommissioning and repowering][41] solutions. Our experienced teams manage turbine
dismantling, component removal, and site restoration, ensuring compliance with [environmental and
safety standards][42]. We also support repowering projects by preparing sites for next-generation
turbines, helping customers extend the value and performance of their wind assets.

Training & Workforce Development

Through the [European Wind Academy][43], FairWind provides specialised training programmes for wind
industry technicians. Our training focuses on safety, technical skills, and industry best practices,
helping develop a highly skilled workforce capable of supporting modern wind turbine technology both
onshore and offshore.

Global Technical Expertise

With highly trained technicians and international project experience, FairWind provides flexible
technical support wherever wind farms operate. Our [teams][44] integrate seamlessly with client
operations to deliver safe, reliable, and efficient service worldwide.

## Global presence

FairWind operates globally, combining local expertise with world-class standards. Through strategic
partnerships with Cosmic in APAC and the European Wind Academy in Europe and Australia, we
strengthen our presence and drive excellence across all regions.

Cosmic Group

In partnership with [Cosmic][45], FairWind can combine local expertise with alignment to its global
systems, standards, and strategic vision. This business serves as the regional hub for FairWind’s
APAC operations.

Rope Partner

[Rope Partner ][46]is a US-based leader in at-height wind turbine maintenance and SPRAT-certified
technician training, strengthening FairWind’s service capability and presence across the Americas.

European Wind Academy

The [European Wind Academy][47] empowers professionals with cutting-edge skills and knowledge, while
ensuring alignment with FairWind’s global standards and strategic vision. It also serves as the
central hub for developing talent across FairWind’s operations.

With nearly two decades of experience in the renewable energy sector, FairWind delivers specialist
services across the full lifecycle of wind turbine operations. Our expert technicians support
onshore and offshore wind projects worldwide, helping developers, OEMs, and asset owners install,
maintain, and optimise their assets safely and efficiently.

Installation & Preassembly

FairWind supports wind farm construction with experienced technical teams delivering turbine
[installation and preassembly][39] services. Our specialists ensure turbines are assembled safely,
efficiently, and to the highest quality standards, supporting projects from early construction
through to commissioning.

Operations & Maintenance

Our preventive and corrective [maintenance services][40] help wind turbines operate reliably and
efficiently throughout their operational life. By identifying issues early and responding quickly
when faults occur, we help minimise downtime and maximise energy production.

Decommissioning & Repowering

As wind farms reach the end of their operational life, FairWind supports customers with safe,
efficient [decommissioning and repowering][41] solutions. Our experienced teams manage turbine
dismantling, component removal, and site restoration, ensuring compliance with [environmental and
safety standards][42]. We also support repowering projects by preparing sites for next-generation
turbines, helping customers extend the value and performance of their wind assets.

Training & Workforce Development

Through the [European Wind Academy][43], FairWind provides specialised training programmes for wind
industry technicians. Our training focuses on safety, technical skills, and industry best practices,
helping develop a highly skilled workforce capable of supporting modern wind turbine technology both
onshore and offshore.

Global Technical Expertise

With highly trained technicians and international project experience, FairWind provides flexible
technical support wherever wind farms operate. Our [teams][44] integrate seamlessly with client
operations to deliver safe, reliable, and efficient service worldwide.

## Global presence

FairWind operates globally, combining local expertise with world-class standards. Through strategic
partnerships with Cosmic in APAC and the European Wind Academy in Europe and Australia, we
strengthen our presence and drive excellence across all regions.

Cosmic Group

In partnership with [Cosmic][45], FairWind can combine local expertise with alignment to its global
systems, standards, and strategic vision. This business serves as the regional hub for FairWind’s
APAC operations.

Rope Partner

[Rope Partner ][46]is a US-based leader in at-height wind turbine maintenance and SPRAT-certified
technician training, strengthening FairWind’s service capability and presence across the Americas.

European Wind Academy

The [European Wind Academy][47] empowers professionals with cutting-edge skills and knowledge, while
ensuring alignment with FairWind’s global standards and strategic vision. It also serves as the
central hub for developing talent across FairWind’s operations.

# How to store electricity?

Electricity can be stored in several ways: electrochemical, mechanical, electromagnetic, biological,
thermal, and chemical. **How to store electricity from renewable energy sources** is a massive
problem. I am sure you have seen one of energy storage types, such as batteries, pumped hydro energy
storage, gravity energy storage, compressed air energy storage or hydrogen storage.

You use power banks, batteries in a mobile phone, or laptop, **stored energy can be used later**

# How to store electricity?

Electricity can be stored in several ways: electrochemical, mechanical, electromagnetic, biological,
thermal, and chemical. **How to store electricity from renewable energy sources** is a massive
problem. I am sure you have seen one of energy storage types, such as batteries, pumped hydro energy
storage, gravity energy storage, compressed air energy storage or hydrogen storage.

when you need it!

The most popular way to store energy are batteries, leading electrochemical technologies are LFP
(LiFePO4), Li-Ion, Lead-Acid, NiMH, NCA, LMO, LCO, NMC, LTO and many more [battery types][8].

[[BESS Revenue Stacking: How Batteries Actually Make Money in 2026][BESS Revenue Stacking: How
Batteries Actually Make Money in 2026]][51]

## [BESS Revenue Stacking: How Batteries Actually Make Money in 2026][52]

by [Kamil Talar, MSc.][53] | Jul 4, 2026 | [Markets & Revenue][54]

A battery makes money like a freelancer with five clients – many small jobs, one at a time, juggled
brilliantly. Why an identical battery earns EUR 60k/MW in one market and EUR 200k in another, the
layers of the stack, and why revenue is earned, not received.

[read more][55]
[[BESS Network Tariffs and Double-Charging 2026: The Cost Nobody Puts on a Slide][BESS Network
Tariffs and Double-Charging 2026: The Cost Nobody Puts on a Slide]][56]

## [BESS Network Tariffs and Double-Charging 2026: The Cost Nobody Puts on a Slide][57]

by [Kamil Talar, MSc.][58] | Jul 3, 2026 | [Policy & Regulation][59]

A cost that hits every cycle, appears in no headline, and can decide whether a battery makes money:
the network tariff. The double-charging injustice, why models underweight it, and the shift toward
signal-based charges that reward grid-friendly batteries – even paying them.

[read more][60]
[[The EU Battery Passport in 2026: Why the Cheapest Cell Is No Longer the Cheapest Compliant
Cell][The EU Battery Passport in 2026: Why the Cheapest Cell Is No Longer the Cheapest Compliant
Cell]][61]

## [The EU Battery Passport in 2026: Why the Cheapest Cell Is No Longer the Cheapest Compliant
## Cell][62]

by [Kamil Talar, MSc.][63] | Jul 2, 2026 | [Policy & Regulation][64]

A cost that shows up in no energy market: the EU Batteries Regulation. Carbon-footprint declarations
from Feb 2026, the battery passport from Feb 2027, and the intricate carve-out for stationary
storage. How compliance turned ‘cheapest cell’ into ‘cheapest compliant cell’.

[read more][65]
[[Australia’s Capacity Investment Scheme: The Revenue Underwrite That May Be the Best
Model][Australia’s Capacity Investment Scheme: The Revenue Underwrite That May Be the Best
Model]][66]

## [Australia’s Capacity Investment Scheme: The Revenue Underwrite That May Be the Best Model][67]

by [Kamil Talar, MSc.][68] | Jul 1, 2026 | [Policy & Regulation][69]

Australia does what no other market does: instead of paying batteries, it underwrites their revenue
– a floor beneath the market, upside preserved, taxpayer exposed only to genuine downside. Why the
underwrite may be the most efficient de-risking tool in global storage policy.

[read more][70]
[[BESS in Spain 2026: How a Blackout Rewrote the Rules and Grew Storage 589%][BESS in Spain 2026:
How a Blackout Rewrote the Rules and Grew Storage 589%]][71]

## [BESS in Spain 2026: How a Blackout Rewrote the Rules and Grew Storage 589%][72]

by [Kamil Talar, MSc.][73] | Jun 30, 2026 | [Policy & Regulation][74]

In five seconds Spain lost 60% of its demand and went dark. A year later, battery capacity grew 589%
– from 28 MW to 193 MW – as the blackout converted storage from optional to imperative. The rawest
proof that in storage, the binding constraint is regulation, not technology.

[read more][75]
[[Italy’s MACSE Auction 2026: How Storage Contracts Cracked the Cost of Capital][Italy’s MACSE
Auction 2026: How Storage Contracts Cracked the Cost of Capital]][76]

## [Italy’s MACSE Auction 2026: How Storage Contracts Cracked the Cost of Capital][77]

by [Kamil Talar, MSc.][78] | Jun 29, 2026 | [Policy & Regulation][79]

Italy’s first MACSE auction was four times oversubscribed and cleared far below expectations – 10
GWh at roughly EUR 12,959/MWh/year on 15-year contracts. The reason is the deepest lesson in storage
economics: a bankable contract attacks the cost of capital, not the capex.

[read more][80]
[[BESS in the United States 2026: The Strongest Market, the Thickest Compliance Shell][BESS in the
United States 2026: The Strongest Market, the Thickest Compliance Shell]][81]

## [BESS in the United States 2026: The Strongest Market, the Thickest Compliance Shell][82]

by [Kamil Talar, MSc.][83] | Jun 28, 2026 | [Policy & Regulation][84]

Heading toward 40 GW installed – and every project runs a gauntlet of 50%+ tariffs, tax-credit rules
tied to a four-country blacklist, and interconnection costs reaching 60% of capex. FERC 841/2222,
FEOC, and why US developers now spend more time with trade lawyers than engineers.

by [Kamil Talar, MSc.][88] | Jun 27, 2026 | [Policy & Regulation][89]

The EU layer moves slowly and speaks in acronyms – and it is rewriting the baseline every national
battery market must follow. Market Design reform making flexibility law, the Grids Package ending
first-come-first-served, REMIT II compliance, and the double-charging fight.

[[BESS in Germany 2026: The Grid-Fee Deadline Reshaping the Whole Pipeline][BESS in Germany 2026:

exemption, the harder 2027 FID gate beneath it, and the forward-looking AgNes framework where
grid-friendly batteries could be paid rather than charged.

#### Travelling Load Stabilising System

the Travelling Load Stabilising System, for universal application in heavy lifting cranes. 

[Read more][76]

#### Wind gust buster

Huisman launched of a newly developed system, called Wind Gust Buster to assist crane operators and
lifting supervisors when working with the installation of large objects at considerable height, by
providing information on the incoming wind 360° around the boom tip.

[Read more][77]

#### Windfarm installation vessel

To improve the efficiency of offshore windfarm installation, Huisman has developed the Windfarm
Installation Vessel (WIV); a semi-submersible vessel with a 3D motion compensated WTG installation
system.

 

[Read more][78]

#### Convertible Pre-Piling Template

With offshore wind farms being built in ever deeper waters, there is a growing demand for jacket
foundations to support the increasingly larger Wind Turbine Generators. These jacket foundations
come in different designs to accommodate the varying conditions and parameters of the wind farm
locations. Huisman introduces the Convertible Pre-Piling Template, an economic and reliable solution
for accurate piling.

[Read more][79]

#### Motion compensated platform

Huisman introduces the Motion Compensated Platform to ensure that components can be transferred
quickly and safely from a feeder vessel.

[Read more][80]

#### Universal quick connector

Rigging operations can take up valuable time of your consecutive offshore operations. With the
Universal Quick Connector, Huisman offers a safe and efficient solution to reduce your cycle time
and mitigate the safety risks of people involved in changing installation tools. 

[Read more][81]

#### Motion compensated monopile gripper

The Motion Compensated Monopile Gripper is designed by Huisman to allow monopile installations from
a floating vessel while controlling the vertical alignment of the monopile.

[Read more][82]

## / innovations

[[Travelling Load Stabilising System]][69][[Wind gust buster]][70][[Windfarm installation
vessel]][71][[Convertible Pre-Piling Template]][72][[Motion compensated platform]][73][[Universal
quick connector]][74][[Motion compensated monopile gripper]][75]

#### Travelling Load Stabilising System

Controlling the movements of the relatively light blades of a turbine when suspended from a crane,
has proven to be an installation challenge due to wind load. Huisman and Siemens Gamesa developed
the Travelling Load Stabilising System, for universal application in heavy lifting cranes. 

[Read more][76]

#### Wind gust buster

Huisman launched of a newly developed system, called Wind Gust Buster to assist crane operators and
lifting supervisors when working with the installation of large objects at considerable height, by
providing information on the incoming wind 360° around the boom tip.

[Read more][77]

#### Windfarm installation vessel

To improve the efficiency of offshore windfarm installation, Huisman has developed the Windfarm
Installation Vessel (WIV); a semi-submersible vessel with a 3D motion compensated WTG installation
system.

 

[Read more][78]

#### Convertible Pre-Piling Template

With offshore wind farms being built in ever deeper waters, there is a growing demand for jacket
foundations to support the increasingly larger Wind Turbine Generators. These jacket foundations
come in different designs to accommodate the varying conditions and parameters of the wind farm
locations. Huisman introduces the Convertible Pre-Piling Template, an economic and reliable solution
for accurate piling.

[Read more][79]

#### Motion compensated platform

Huisman introduces the Motion Compensated Platform to ensure that components can be transferred
quickly and safely from a feeder vessel.

[Read more][80]

#### Universal quick connector

Rigging operations can take up valuable time of your consecutive offshore operations. With the
Universal Quick Connector, Huisman offers a safe and efficient solution to reduce your cycle time
and mitigate the safety risks of people involved in changing installation tools. 

[Read more][81]

#### Motion compensated monopile gripper

The Motion Compensated Monopile Gripper is designed by Huisman to allow monopile installations from
a floating vessel while controlling the vertical alignment of the monopile.

[Read more][82]

# What is IREC
# all about?
* Public research centre focused on advancing sustainable energy.
* Creating scientific knowledge with real technological impact.
* Driving the energy transition through research and innovation.
* Working with partners to advance the future of clean energy.

[Multidisciplinary research and innovation ecosystem focused on sustainable energy]

## Discover IREC

Learn who we are and how our research drives innovation in sustainable energy.

[See more][165]

## Who we are

IREC is a public research centre within the CERCA system, founded in 2008 and dedicated to research,
development, innovation and demonstration in sustainable energy.

Our work spans the full scope of the energy transition, from fundamental science to applied
research, with the aim of generating knowledge that is relevant to industry, public administrations
and society. Through collaboration with research groups, institutions and companies, we help drive
the energy transition and strengthen the role of science in building a cleaner and more resilient
future.

[Entrance of IREC in Barcelona, the headquarters of the Catalonia Institute for Energy Research, a
centre focused on renewable energy research, innovation, and the energy transition.]
[Discover our departments][166]
[Foto del equipo de IREC en el Institut de Recerca en Energia de Catalunya (Barcelona), mostrando
investigadores y profesionales que impulsan la innovación en energías renovables, tecnologías
limpias y soluciones sostenibles alineadas con los retos energéticos globales y la competitividad
industrial.]

## Meet our team

Discover the people behind our science, innovation and sustainable energy goals.

[Discover our team][167]
[Investigador de IREC sosteniendo un dispositivo energético flexible en un laboratorio,
representando la investigación avanzada en tecnologías de energías renovables, la innovación y
soluciones sostenibles para abordar los retos energéticos globales y mejorar la competitividad
industrial.]

## What we do

We conduct research, development and innovation across the full spectrum of sustainable energy, from
the fundamental properties of new materials to the integration of renewable technologies, from the
decarbonisation of industry to the design of more efficient buildings and communities.

Our work connects scientific knowledge with real-world application, supporting the energy transition
at every scale: from laboratory to field demonstration, and from solutions relevant to Catalonia and
Spain to contributions to the European research agenda.

# Innovative Solutions For
# **A Sustainable Future**

NMDC Group is an integrated energy and marine services, engineering, procurement, and construction
(EPC) organization with a footprint spanning the MENA region, South Asia, and beyond. We work on
highly ambitious projects, delivering innovative solutions to even the most complex challenges.

[ About Us ][40]

## About NMDC Group

NMDC Group is a prominent figure in the fields of engineering, marine dredging, procurement, and
construction, working in the Middle East and further afield.

We specialize in providing innovative solutions for those vital sectors at the core of the UAE
economy. This includes addressing the complex future challenges facing the energy EPC sector.

Under our umbrella, we own and operate five business units: NMDC Dredging & Marine, NMDC Energy,
NMDC Infra, NMDC Engineering, and NMDC LTS.

[ Read More About NMDC Group ][41]

## Business Units

### NMDC Dredging & Marine

Leading the field of marine dredging, reclamation, and construction, NMDC Dredging & Marine delivers
projects of superior quality. With years of international experience, we are known for our
exceptional track record and commitment to generating true value for all stakeholders.

[ Visit Website ][42]

### NMDC Energy

NMDC Energy is focused on providing engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) solutions to
the energy sector. With comprehensive services tailored to both offshore and onshore clients in the
oil & gas and energy industries, NMDC Energy is designed to continuously meet the industry’s
challenges.

[ Visit Website ][43]

### NMDC Engineering

A leading coastal and marine engineering consultancy, NMDC Engineering has experience working across
marine, civil, hydraulics, geotechnical, and environmental engineering. Across the Arabian Gulf and
the Middle East, NMDC Engineering is enabling the completion of some of the largest marine,
waterfront, and oil & gas infrastructure.

[ Visit Website ][44]

### NMDC Infra

A pioneering construction technology business, NMDC Infra is leading the way when it comes to
precast concrete. With cutting-edge technology and extensive experience, we offer complete,
sustainable, and affordable precast solutions for all construction products, delivering a wide range
of structural and architectural elements.

[ Visit Website ][45]

### NMDC LTS

NMDC LTS (NMDC Logistics & Technical Services) delivers industry-leading support for complex
infrastructure projects, leveraging decades of EPC expertise to ensure seamless execution. With a
solution-driven approach, we drive operational excellence and efficiency across the construction and
industrial sectors, facilitating sustainable growth.
